verdict.strongest_supported_claim: For the explicit natural column-vector action of H=<A,B> in SL_2(F_29), G=F_29^2 semidirect H has order 100920 and b_f(G)=b(G)=3<4=mu_prime(G), with b maximizing inclusion-minimal base size over all faithful or nonfaithful permutation representations and mu_prime permitting nongenerating independent subsets.
exact_checked_claims: All-actions subgroup formulation requires normal total intersection; faithful formulation requires trivial intersection. Meet-irredundance without normality equals maximum independent subset size.
The restriction lemma applies to arbitrary subgroup families and to nongenerating independent subsets.
Concrete complement has 120 elements, is isomorphic to SL_2(5), has A_5 quotient by its unique involution, mu_prime=b=3 and faithful base invariant 2.
Thirty line stabilizers are cyclic of order four, with faithful scalar action and no nonidentity fixed vectors; prime-field and gcd restrictions are essential.
Every subgroup missing V has faithful base invariant at most two. All 1770 subgroups meeting V in a line, including all affine lifts, satisfy the verified scalar classification.
Irreducibility and faithfulness imply every nontrivial normal subgroup of G contains V; hence all nonfaithful actions factor through H.
Universal faithful/nonfaithful base upper bound three and unrestricted independence upper bound four follow structurally, without enumerating the full G subgroup lattice.
Printed independent generating four-set, omission orders and nonnormal order-two bottom; printed faithful minimal triple and degree5220; core replacement destroys irredundance.
Exact printed characteristic11 four-family shows the characteristic-independent extension is false.

verdict.followup_rationale: No public follow-up is proposed. Minimum-order counterexamples, larger gaps and a classification of suitable affine groups are plausible directions, but this review has not established a new mechanism or enough evidence to justify a specific substantial conjecture.
key_boundaries: The construction is not claimed to have the smallest possible group order. It does not classify all counterexamples or determine the largest possible gap between the invariants.

The result concerns inclusion-minimal bases maximized over all actions. It should not be described as a result only about transitive actions, minimum-size bases in one fixed action, or ordered irredundant bases.
Faithful and arbitrary actions must remain distinct. For the complement H itself, b_f(H) = 2 while b(H) = 3; omitting nonfaithful actions would change the problem.
The characteristic matters. The paper exhibits a related characteristic-11 construction with a faithful minimal base of size four, so the same conclusion is not established for every finite field.

Finite exact verifiers check the explicit matrix groups and witnesses. The upper bound for every subgroup and action of the full affine group relies on the structural proof, rather than exhaustive enumeration of its subgroup lattice.

The official notebook’s reported confirmation is evidence of external recognition, not a journal acceptance or proof-assistant certificate. This page does not claim an exhaustive priority search beyond the cited primary sources.
